proposed_architecture: through-bolted structural plate concept; not authorized or selected

a66_face_option.product: Simpson Strong-Tie A66, two 3/8-inch through bolts per leg
a66_face_option.outward_shift: The earlier 5/10/15 mm screen moved both principals and posts and did not de-stack their header bolts. Owner clarified posts only, with inner kicker-edge support preserved; the post-only AB205 trial is separately screened and no offset selected.
a66_face_option.capacity_basis: unresolved; no A66 bolt-mode allowable load adopted

ab205_center_fit_trial.hole_row_at_current_clip_y: four nominal 9/16-inch bores penetrate raw wood but the far principal bore misses the conditional reversible 4D loaded-edge screen by 29.073 mm
ab205_center_fit_trial.relocated_hole_row: long leg vertical: only a 0.148-mm common nominal 4D Y interval; short leg vertical: 9.774 mm, but the near principal hole approaches its oblique end. Neither position is released
ab205_center_fit_trial.short_vertical_midband: At Y=-95.382 mm, four nominal bores occupy raw wood and intersect none of the 66 retained panel or 12 retained frame-bolt occupied axes in the kerf-right packet. This is only an axis screen; the opposing replacement connector, product body, washers, tool access, tolerances, and resistance remain open
ab205_center_fit_trial.opposed_post_nominal_screen: A short-vertical trial for the underside center-post station has two nominal through-header axes coincident with the top trial, for six unique wood-bore axes rather than eight independent axes. All post bores occupy raw timber and none of the six axes intersects retained panel/frame-bolt axes. This does not establish a shared bolt stack, angle-body clearance, end-distance interpretation, or resistance

shared_header_method_gate.limit: Two steel flanges around one wood header with potentially unequal actions cannot be treated as two independent full-header single-shear capacities

shared_header_grip_screen.limit: Two nominal steel flanges plus the wood header make a 2-inch pre-washer stack; common 3-inch Grade 5 retail bolts are dimensional leads only, with delivered shoulder, washer, nut and access unresolved

post_only_outward_shift_trial.disposition: At 5/10 mm, distinct nominal header bores overlap. At 15 mm, bores separate by only 0.7125 mm wood web and the axes remain below the conditional 3D minimum for separate half-inch bolts. Physical kerf-right kicker-edge overhang increases and frozen screw-edge material falls; none is selected or released.

ab205_center_fit_trial.end_distance: principal grain is inclined and bottom end is oblique; vertical bolt offset is not an NDS end distance, and the along-grain ray is not classified as pass/fail
ab205_center_fit_trial.capacity_basis: unresolved; ABB's strut-channel load is not a wood-joint rating

disposition: The relocated station must be carried into any future detail. No bolt direction or plate can be accepted until opposing hardware, bearing faces, and access are resolved at the actual station.
